name: Omahold
author: ZeD
description: A miniature dwarf fortress in your bar. Eight z-levels of dwarves who take the orders you file but reach for the trade they love, ruin work when they are tired, and bury their dead in a corner they pick themselves. Dig deep for better metal; six milestones make the hold legendary. English or Portuguese, in your theme's colors.

barWidget.description: The hold's population; lights up when something happens. Click opens the world, right click toggles the corner window.
